item.title: Ergonomic Hacks for Sedentary Tech Workers
item.summary: Tech work keeps software developers and system engineers attached to desk stations for 8 to 12 hours a day. Long desk sessions slowly take a toll on physical health, leading to tight joints and sluggish energy levels. Small workplace upgrades create dramatic shifts in daily comfort and focus.
